verdict.rationale: Foreloop routes agent work through git checkouts and opens PRs, and requires human approval before changes run, which gives an implicit review/approval layer and git-native versioning of code changes (foreloop-docs-3, foreloop-docs-7, foreloop-docs-15). However there is no explicit documentation of a rollback mechanism for automations/tasks/skills themselves, nor a dedicated version history UI for automations beyond relying on git/GitHub semantics. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/undo feature for automations, versioned history of tasks/skills/contracts, and any evidence of reverting an executed automation.
